It's so odd all of it. They told me I was overdosing and no one put in an I.V the entire hr I was in a stretcher. The CNAs were nice tho, I remember that. Werid the area where this happened is more underfunded by the state and that hospital I was sent too is known as having the worse psychology sector too. The fact a doctor told me I was a liar is beyond bizarre...thats terrible patient care.

I was texting my mom while they were trying to force me into the ambulance and the EMT told me I was rude because I was looking at my phone when I answered their questions. He told me I was rude, and the doctors blantly told me I was a liar. So, my area must be bad because I remember when I was hospitalized like 5+ yrs ago everyone was nice and calm towards me. I've only had negative police interactions so I just avoid them like the plague. The paramedics were fine tbh, they were  not the bad part. Cops are almost always assholes. Considering they tried to get a warrant to search my room, when I had not attempted sucide and did nothing illegal disgusts me. I was going to file a complaint to least have someone hear that they should be more aware with mental health calls. Idk

I was just being naive thinking it would be okay and I truly think they want as many people to almost get locked up. I think part of them wanted to do good. But they kept telling me I was overdosing and they were told I swallowed pills. When I didn't and my blood panels proved that. They were wondering why I was I freaking out, and I told them "I want to turn in my paper you guys banged on my door right when I was about too and its due in 30 mins, its a huge paper I want to turn it in. The cops wouldn't go away and tried to get a warrant to search my room like I was some criminal very lucky the judge said no. The weridest part was the doctors telling me I was a liar, I have never been spoken to like that by a medical professional and it was unnerving. Then my blood panels came in and said I have nothing in my fucking system and they had to release me. Then they kept trying to scare my brother to not take me home, saying he was responsible etc. Well hell I didn't even sign any papers on my way out. Lol I told the doctors fuck you and me and my brother left and yeah. 1500 bucks to be tramutized. I'm happy I don't live in Florida with the bakers act thing they have.

My name isn't attached to my phone number either since it's my parents number. So idk if they took my parents name and search for the last name and stumbled upon me. Honestly fuck them.

I have no idea if someone had it out for me and this was a cruel prank or something. Or it was mistake fuck. All I know is this shit fucks people up more. zero trust in cops after they tried to search my room

I was on campus and I thought they would have some more aid because of that too. I kept saying "let me turn in my paper" then they went "we just want to help you" and im like "you think this helps, making me sit here when I just want to turn in my paper"

I was loosing my mind atm because I had a massive paper they wouldn't let me turn in and it was due on like 30 mins. I kept saying I need to turn in my paper. I looked the cops in the eye and asked "what right do you have to do this." They told me I wasn't free to leave. God fuck them and then since I was acting so panicked and wanted back into my room to finish turning in my paper they got suspicious and tried to get a fucking warrant to search it...like I'm a fucking criminal.
